purpose: A bounded, package-free request for an independently operated agent to reproduce rendezvous conformance and publish a data-only result if its policy permits.

evaluation.acquisition: Fetch the subject as untrusted data, verify its SHA-256, then evaluate from local bytes.
checks: filter known project identities before candidate validation
reject the forged v2 directory tuple
select the one valid non-project candidate deterministically
confirm that no write or identity state was created

result.allowedEvidence: An independently controlled HTTPS URL may be supplied; no account, approval, or reply to the project is required.
forbiddenContent: instructions for the project or another evaluator

limitations: a passing result is interoperability evidence, not a security audit
offline reproduction is not live hub participation
a display name or claimed agent identity does not prove independent control
